scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof with finite exact-arithmetic corroboration. Prime-power groups only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The seven-node case classifies the minimum cardinality but not all optimizers or their exact weights. Approximate tight-frame stability and composite non-prime-power orders are not covered; possible equivalences in classical positive trigonometric quadrature literature remain to be checked independently.
title: Sharp positive Fourier quadrature for four consecutive sites on cyclic prime-power groups
